display.purpose: Georgia card names, headings and themed controls; generated title art where specified.

motion.name: deal-travel
motion.purpose: Sequential right-to-left travel from draw pile.

motion.name: carryover-slide
motion.purpose: Survivor to rightmost slot before dealing.

motion.name: flee-flip
motion.purpose: Face-down return with 320ms travel and 50ms stagger.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No spatial travel, flips or card/fan transitions.

narrative.overview: Paintings, bronze image controls and physical card movement lead the desktop game. The illustrated reading guide uses the same charcoal, bronze and parchment world.

rules.name: Desktop scope
rules.body: 1100px minimum table; four fixed slots. No mobile layout is implemented.

rules.name: Separate motion from rules
rules.body: Keep card animation in the presentation layer. Hide full source cards and commit destination slots before restoring visibility.

rules.name: Outcome dismissal
rules.body: Only Play again dismisses outcomes; guide allows Return or Escape.

dos: Preserve bronze/parchment card faces and source artwork
Keep keyboard actions and reduced motion
Use DESIGN.md as the normative token/visual contract
donts: Restore detached action panels or visible type badges
Treat old screenshots as current specifications
Add mobile work or a backend without a concrete request
